## Motivation

With prefill TP smaller than decode TP, Mooncake still sends SWA head slices as many small ranges, even when full KV uses staging.

## Modifications

Add default-off `SGLANG_MOONCAKE_SWA_PACKING`: gather destination-local heads and write whole pages directly into the final SWA pool. Validate NHD/GQA geometry and page bounds; unsupported peers fall back before submission. Registered scratch defaults to 64 MiB per initialized worker. Uncertain completion quarantines buffers. Existing full-KV staging and native Mooncake are unchanged.

Usage, eligibility and failure semantics: [Mooncake SWA sender packing](https://github.com/Lzy17/sglang/blob/perf/mooncake-swa-packing/docs/docs/advanced_features/pd_disaggregation.mdx#mooncake-swa-sender-packing).

## Accuracy Tests

15 CPU tests pass. Earlier MI355X RDMA fixtures passed byte/sentinel checks; 498 fixed-prompt requests matched the greedy reference. Model results use the documented pre-extraction source and experimental ROCm Muse runtime from #44667; this standalone rebase has CPU validation.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Muse 816B MXFP4, P4/D8, C1, ISL1024/OSL2, full staging enabled: direct/packed/direct median TTFT **287.4 / 129.4 / 289.1 ms** (30 measured requests per arm). OSL64 total latency/ITL did not improve. Full statistics, source revisions and validation limits are recorded below.

Related: #44615 and #47312. This PR applies independently of the MoRI draft.

## Historical benchmark and validation evidence

These measurements describe the original integration, not the current PR head. No new GPU or model measurements were performed for this documentation cleanup.

### Reading the results

- P4/D8 means prefill attention tensor parallelism (TP) 4 and decode attention TP 8.
- ISL and OSL mean input and output sequence length in tokens; OSL1, OSL2 and OSL64 mean 1, 2 and 64 output tokens. C1 means one concurrent request.
- TTFT is time to first token, E2E is end-to-end request latency, and ITL is inter-token latency. p50 and p95 are the 50th and 95th percentiles.
- Direct A and Direct B are baseline runs before and after the packed run, with SWA packing disabled. They bracket the packed run to help expose drift; they are not different transfer algorithms.

### Validation environment

Results below were recorded against integration `8854b6998e`, based on SGLang
`1776e2dcf8`, on two AMD Instinct MI355X nodes. Recorded gates passed **51 CPU/GPU
checks plus 3 subtests**, including metadata/wire compatibility, failure ownership,
MoRI regressions and actual GPU/native transfer correctness. This historical
gate count applies to that integration snapshot, rather than the new PR head.

The initial standalone extraction was based on main `acdad27d74`. It retains the
tested Mooncake transfer algorithm, uses the backend-neutral `kv_pack_layout`
field, and adds only the generic setup proof needed by Mooncake. No MoRI backend
changes are included. The tables describe the original tested revision; the
816B model measurements have **not** been repeated on this newer base. The
extraction passed 15 focused CPU tests (the existing 10 cases plus 5 setup/wire
regressions); GPU/native/model validation on the extracted head and subsequent rebases remains separate.

- Image: `lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.22-rocm10-mi35x-20261028`.
- Image ID: `sha256:b51edf074b567263afb19be9108756645ee00d0604374b6e4c5006caccaa17fe`.
- Mooncake `engine.so` SHA256: `13c648be36887ae362b4dbd9851268d2075c152be9dd8214cf7d2fb410fbf3ac`.
  Installed distribution version metadata was unavailable; a separate source
  checkout is not evidence of this binary's revision.
- Model: `amd/Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B-Quark-MXFP4`, revision
  `c7bc74fd64371315a091bc15f9723882eead0dc1`.
- Experimental ROCm Muse runtime from PR #44667, revision
  `37197b72708c0bc6f89c5c54a1719df22455613c`, with isolated routing-call and
  optional logits-output-buffer compatibility fixes. These results do not imply
  that unmodified upstream Muse serving works with this image.

### Native one-peer microbenchmark

Logical P4 rank 0 → D8 rank 1; 16 global KV heads, head dimension 64, BF16,
page size 16, 1,024 tokens and four SWA layers. Independent random source and
destination pages; 2 MiB useful payload. Both arms use the same thread-pool
concurrency and **8 native batch calls**; logical entries fall from 8,192 to 512.
The baseline rebuilds equivalent NumPy address plans inside timing. Registration
is outside timing. GPU reads, destination bytes and untouched guards matched.

Sender completion time in ms; 8 warmups and 30 samples per arm/block:

| Block | Direct mean / p50 / p95 | Packed mean / p50 / p95 |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 4.307 / 4.311 / 4.434 | 0.734 / 0.730 / 0.766 |
| 2 | 4.415 / 4.423 / 4.506 | 0.737 / 0.737 / 0.761 |
| 3 | 4.575 / 4.570 / 4.835 | 0.736 / 0.735 / 0.765 |

Input entries are not hardware work queue element (WQE) counts. This fixture is not model serving.

### Real Muse: full staging disabled

P4 → D8, 1,024 input tokens, BF16 KV/page16, concurrency **1**. Graphs, radix
cache and overlap scheduling disabled; chunked prefill disabled. Direct A →
SWA packed → direct B, fresh prefill processes and one shared decode process.
Each OSL1 arm has 16 warmups and 100 measured requests. All samples, including
outliers, are retained. Times are serial direct-HTTP observations in ms.

| Arm | TTFT mean / p50 / p95 | E2E mean / p50 / p95 |
|---|---|---|
| Direct A | 356.971 / 342.751 / 349.779 | 357.123 / 342.887 / 349.912 |
| SWA packed | 181.879 / 181.640 / 185.372 | 182.000 / 181.736 / 185.494 |
| Direct B | 348.079 / 341.803 / 345.365 | 348.227 / 341.993 / 345.518 |

TTFT p50 decreased about 46.9% against the two direct p50 values' average.
Direct-arm means include retained latency outliers; this is not a significance
test or a throughput result.

Additional OSL64 checks used 8 warmups + 10 measured requests per arm:

| Arm | TTFT mean / p50 / p95 | E2E mean / p50 / p95 | Observed mean ITL: mean / p50 / p95 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Direct A | 340.772 / 341.130 / 344.246 | 4501.032 / 4472.139 / 4644.162 | 66.034 / 65.565 / 68.266 |
| SWA packed | 180.778 / 180.908 / 182.363 | 4493.121 / 4491.240 / 4515.162 | 68.448 / 68.401 / 68.790 |

Earlier first-token arrival did **not** establish faster total generation or
ITL. These 10-request arms do not establish tail probabilities.

### Real Muse: existing full staging enabled

All arms set `SGLANG_DISAGG_STAGING_BUFFER=1` and
`--chunked-prefill-size 1024`; the 1,024-token prompt fits one forward and one
staging grid slot. Do not compare this with the upstream `-1` staging-grid
behavior, which produces one-page slots. Other settings match above; OSL2,
8 warmups + 30 measured requests per arm, direct A → packed → direct B,
with the same decode process throughout.

| Arm | TTFT mean / p50 / p95 | E2E mean / p50 / p95 |
|---|---|---|
| Direct A | 286.882 / 287.429 / 289.765 | 385.824 / 389.635 / 394.622 |
| SWA packed | 129.459 / 129.411 / 130.689 | 224.547 / 224.997 / 227.786 |
| Direct B | 287.379 / 289.136 / 292.027 | 384.063 / 389.849 / 397.773 |

Against the two direct p50 values' average, TTFT decreased **55.1%** and E2E
decreased **42.3%**. Separate diagnostic requests proved successful full staging
on every P rank, completed scatter on every D rank, and SWA packing hits.
Diagnostic hooks were removed; both roles restarted and source hashes verified
identical before formal timing. No diagnostic instrumentation ran during timing.

Across the two configurations, **498 requests** matched the independent greedy
reference: 348 OSL1 + 36 OSL64 + 114 OSL2, including warmups. Each had exactly
1,024 prompt tokens; decode produced 2,880 output tokens in total. The two
path-proof diagnostic requests are excluded from these counts. Both roles'
native RDMA installation was verified and `MC_FORCE_TCP` was absent.

These are low-concurrency, text-only results for one model/workload and an
experimental runtime. They establish neither broad concurrency scaling nor
decode-compute acceleration. Raw artifacts, exact commands, source hashes and
per-request output IDs are retained separately; private node addresses and raw
logs are intentionally not included here.

   --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
 ```
 
+### Mooncake SWA sender packing
+
+For hybrid sliding-window attention (SWA) models with a smaller prefill attention
+TP size than decode attention TP size, you can pack the destination's KV-head
+slice on the sender and transfer whole pages into the final decode SWA pool.
+This option is independent of full-attention KV staging: it does not change that
+path's receive buffer, scatter or completion protocol.
+
+The packed path uses GPU gather kernels and Mooncake RDMA. It has been exercised
+on AMD ROCm with MI355X GPUs; this validation does not establish support for every
+platform on which the general Mooncake backend runs.
+
+#### Configuration
+
+Use matching SGLang builds that include packing support on both peers. On the
+prefill server, set these variables before launching your existing Mooncake PD
+configuration:
+
+```bash
+export SGLANG_MOONCAKE_SWA_PACKING=1
+export SGLANG_MOONCAKE_SWA_PACK_BUFFER_SIZE_MB=64
+```
+
+Packing defaults to disabled. The buffer defaults to 64 MiB per initialized
+sender worker and is allocated and registered when that worker first uses the
+packed path. It must hold at least one destination page per transferred tensor;
+otherwise, the sender falls back before gathering.
+
+On both peers, leave `MC_FORCE_TCP` unset and verify that Mooncake uses RDMA.
+Mooncake checks whether that variable exists, so setting it to `0` can still
+force TCP. Keep `SGLANG_DISAGGREGATION_DEFERRED_DECODE_KV_RELEASE` enabled
+(the default); packing requires deferred decode KV release.
+
+#### Supported layouts and fallback
+
+The packed path requires:
+
+- Prefill attention TP smaller than decode attention TP, with an integer ratio
+  and nonreplicated grouped-query attention (GQA) KV heads.
+- Pipeline parallelism (PP), attention context parallelism (CP), and decode
+  context parallelism (DCP) all set to 1, with no DCP relayout.
+- Ordinary contiguous NHD storage (token, head, head-dimension order) with
+  matching logical and storage dtypes, head dimensions, page geometry, tensor
+  and layer ordering, and registered buffer capacities on both peers.
+- SWA as the only state type and no draft KV entries.
+
+The sender checks peer layout metadata and signed page indices before gathering.
+Missing or malformed optional metadata, unsupported geometry, multi-head latent
+attention (MLA), scale sidecars, unified page envelopes and unsupported state
+layouts preserve the existing transfer path. Packing does not add support for
+layouts that the existing path cannot transfer.
+
+#### Failure and buffer lifetime
+
+Fallback is allowed only before gathering or submission. If a native transfer
+raises or returns a nonzero status, completion is uncertain: the sender retains
+its registered scratch buffer, engine and futures in quarantine, and marks the
+room's deferred abort acknowledgement as unsafe. A completed Python future does
+not prove that timed-out native writes have stopped.
+
+Unsettled GPU gathers also retain their buffers and metadata. Teardown deregisters
+only buffers known to be idle. After submission, the sender does not retry through
+the direct path, where late writes could race with reused memory.
+

+"""Sender-only SWA page packing; uses the existing Mooncake sync executor.
+
+No receiver staging protocol or MoRI transport dependency. A nonzero native
+sync return does not prove the writes stopped: quarantine instead of reusing
+scratch, and let the manager poison the room's deferred abort acknowledgement.
+"""
+
+import threading
+
+_QUARANTINED_SENDERS = []
+
+
+class MooncakePackedSwaSender:
+    def __init__(
+        self, engine, executor, gpu_id, size_bytes, *, buffer=None, gather=None
+    ):
+        if size_bytes <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("Packing buffer must be positive")
+        if buffer is None:
+            from sglang.srt.disaggregation.common.staging_buffer import StagingBuffer
+
+            buffer = StagingBuffer(size_bytes, f"cuda:{gpu_id}", gpu_id)
+        self.engine, self.executor, self.gpu_id = engine, executor, gpu_id
+        self.buffer = buffer
+        self.size_bytes = size_bytes
+        self._gather_override = gather
+        self._lock = threading.Lock()
+        self._pending = []
+        self._gpu_unsettled = False
+        self._ownership = []
+        self._pointers = {}
+        self._quarantined = False
+        self._closed = False
+        engine.register(buffer.get_ptr(), size_bytes)
+
+    def _quarantine(self):
+        self._quarantined = True
+        if self not in _QUARANTINED_SENDERS:
+            _QUARANTINED_SENDERS.append(self)
+
+    def _gather(self, src_ptrs, pages, layout):
+        if self._gather_override is not None:
+            self._gpu_unsettled = True
+            self._gather_override(src_ptrs, pages, layout, self.buffer)
+            self._gpu_unsettled = False
+            return
+        import torch
+        import triton
+
+        from sglang.srt.disaggregation.common.staging_buffer import (
+            _fused_gather_to_staging_kernel,
+        )
+
+        torch.cuda.set_device(self.gpu_id)
+        if torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing():
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "Mooncake SWA packing cannot gather during graph capture"
+            )
+        stream = self.buffer.get_gather_stream()
+        # Independent producer streams must be ordered by the manager's existing
+        # kv_chunk.wait_event before entering this method.
+        stream.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream(self.gpu_id))
+        self._gpu_unsettled = True
+        with torch.cuda.stream(stream):
+            page_ids = torch.tensor(
+                pages, dtype=torch.int64, device=self.buffer.buffer.device
+            )
+            self._ownership.append(page_ids)
+            key = tuple(src_ptrs)
+            pointers = self._pointers.get(key)
+            if pointers is None:
+                pointers = torch.tensor(
+                    key, dtype=torch.int64, device=self.buffer.buffer.device
+                )
+                self._pointers[key] = pointers
+            self._ownership.append(pointers)
+            tensor_bytes = len(pages) * layout.dst_page_bytes
+            _fused_gather_to_staging_kernel[
+                (len(src_ptrs), triton.cdiv(tensor_bytes, 1024))
+            ](
+                pointers,
+                page_ids,
+                self.buffer.buffer,
+                len(pages) * layout.page_size,
+                layout.src_page_bytes // layout.page_size,
+                layout.head_offset_bytes,
+                tensor_bytes,
+                layout.dst_page_bytes // layout.page_size,
+                layout.page_size,
+                1024,
+            )
+        stream.synchronize()
+        self._gpu_unsettled = False
+        self._ownership.clear()
+
+    def send(self, session_id, src_ptrs, dst_ptrs, src_pages, dst_pages, layout):
+        with self._lock:
+            if (
+                self._closed
+                or self._quarantined
+                or self._gpu_unsettled
+                or self._pending
+            ):
+                raise RuntimeError("Mooncake packed sender is not reusable")
+            layout.validate()
+            count = len(src_ptrs)

+                raise ValueError("Unpaired packed transfer")
+            capacity = self.size_bytes // (count * layout.dst_page_bytes)
+            if capacity < 1:
+                raise ValueError("Packing buffer cannot hold one page per tensor")
+            try:
+                for start in range(0, len(src_pages), capacity):
+                    pages = list(src_pages[start : start + capacity])
+                    dst = list(dst_pages[start : start + capacity])

+                            self.buffer.get_ptr()

+                            + i * layout.dst_page_bytes
+                            for i in range(len(pages))

+                        remote = [
+                            int(ptr) + int(page) * layout.dst_page_bytes for page in dst
+                        ]
+                        lengths = [layout.dst_page_bytes] * len(pages)
+                        future = self.executor.submit(
+                            self.engine.batch_transfer_sync,
+                            session_id,
+                            local,
+                            remote,
+                            lengths,
+                        )
+                        self._pending.append(future)
+                    failed = False
+                    for future in self._pending:
+                        try:
+                            failed = (future.result() != 0) or failed
+                        except Exception:
+                            failed = True
+                    if failed:
+                        raise RuntimeError(
+                            "Mooncake packed sync failed; native writes may remain active"

+                    self._pending.clear()

+                # nothing about native timeout cancellation or GPU sync failure.
+                self._quarantine()
+                raise
+            return 0
+
+    def close(self):
+        if not self._lock.acquire(blocking=False):
+            self._quarantine()
+            return False
+        try:
+            if self._quarantined or self._gpu_unsettled or self._pending:
+                self._quarantine()
+                return False
+            if not self._closed:
+                self.engine.deregister(self.buffer.get_ptr())
+                self._closed = True
+                self._pointers.clear()
+            return True
+        finally:
+            self._lock.release()

+PACKED_LAYOUT_VERSION = 2

+def decode_optional_pack_layout(frame):

+
+def prove_packed_transfer(
+    local,
+    remote,
+    component,
+    *,
+    src_tp,
+    dst_tp,
+    src_rank,
+    dst_rank,
+    total_heads,
+    src_ptrs,
+    dst_ptrs,
+    src_item_lens,
+    dst_item_lens,
+    src_layer_ids,
+    dst_layer_ids,

+    dst_pages,

+    try:
+        layout = negotiate_packed_slice(
+            local,
+            remote,
+            component,
+            src_tp=src_tp,
+            dst_tp=dst_tp,
+            src_rank=src_rank,
+            dst_rank=dst_rank,
+            total_heads=total_heads,

+        if layout is None:
+            return None
+        source, destination = local[component], remote[component]
+        count = len(src_ptrs)
+        caps = [source["page_capacities"], destination["page_capacities"]]
+        if (
+            not count
+            or count != len(dst_ptrs)
+            or len(src_item_lens) != count
+            or len(dst_item_lens) != count
+            or list(src_layer_ids) != list(dst_layer_ids)
+            or any(
+                len(values) != count
+                or any(type(n) is not int or n <= 0 for n in values)
+                for values in caps
+            )
+            or any(n != layout.src_page_bytes for n in src_item_lens)
+            or any(n != layout.dst_page_bytes for n in dst_item_lens)
+            or any(operator.index(p) <= 0 for p in list(src_ptrs) + list(dst_ptrs))

+            index = operator.index(page)

+def describe_packable_pool(pool, region=None):
+    """Prove registerable storage is uniform contiguous NHD K/V byte rows."""

+        or len(lengths) != len(buffers)

+        "head_dim": geometry[1],
+        "element_bytes": first.element_size(),
+        "storage_dtype": str(first.dtype),

+    page_size: int

+    dst_page_bytes: int

+        )

+# Mooncake SWA packing validation
+
+For configuration, supported layouts, fallback and failure behavior, see
+[Mooncake SWA sender packing](../../../docs/docs/advanced_features/pd_disaggregation.mdx#mooncake-swa-sender-packing).
+Historical benchmark tables, tested source revisions and validation limits are
+recorded in the [PR description](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/47313#historical-benchmark-and-validation-evidence).
+Those GPU and model results were not measured on the current PR head.
+
+## CPU regression checks
+
+From the repository root, in an environment with SGLang's test dependencies:
+
+```bash
+PYTHONPATH=python python -m unittest discover -s test/registered/unit/disaggregation -p 'test_mooncake_swa_packing.py' -v
+PYTHONPATH=python python -m unittest discover -s test/registered/unit/disaggregation -p 'test_mooncake_packed_setup.py' -v
+```
+
+Both commands should pass. They cover layout proofs, page bounds, optional peer
+metadata compatibility, setup serialization and buffer ownership after uncertain
+completion. They do not validate GPU kernels, native RDMA transfers or model outputs.
+
+## GPU and model validation
+
+The historical GPU harness and raw artifacts are not checked into this directory.
+The PR description records their methodology and limitations; the CPU checks above
+are not a replacement for rerunning GPU and model validation on the target revision.
+
+When validating a new revision:
+
+1. Record both peers' SGLang revisions, Mooncake binary identity, GPU/runtime and
+   model revisions, attention TP sizes, page geometry and packing settings.
+2. Verify that both peers use RDMA and that `MC_FORCE_TCP` is absent. Check copied
+   destination bytes and untouched sentinel regions using independent source and
+   destination page indices.
+3. Compare model outputs with an independent greedy reference. Verify that the
+   intended packed path is exercised; matching output alone does not prove this.
+4. For latency comparisons, bracket a packed run with packing-disabled baseline
+   runs, hold the workload and other settings fixed, report warmups and sample
+   counts, and retain outliers. Report full-KV staging settings separately.
+5. Keep GPU/native/model results tied to the revision actually tested. CPU success
+   or a rebase does not establish that historical GPU results still hold.
